_about: James Ussher (1581-1656), Archbishop of Armagh, the Reformed primate of the Irish Church and the chief author of the Irish Articles of 1615: The Whole Works, now for the first time collected, with a Life of the author and an account of his writings, by Charles Richard Elrington, who died in 1850 before the set was finished (Dublin: Hodges, Smith, 1847-1864, 17 vols); the Princeton copies, whose title pages carry 1864. Volume numbers read off each title page (vol. XII's half-title misprints 'XI'; its contents page reads 'the twelfth volume'). The English-language volumes are shelved; the Latin ones wait in _pending, as the Parker Society's Latin Zurich Letters do. Vol. II is mostly Latin but carries his English sermons and speeches, so it is shelved. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
